description:
Computes the Vimshottari dasha timeline from a birth date, time and place: all nine mahadashas of the 120-year cycle, each with the exact instant it opens and closes, the balance at birth in years, months and days, the Moon's nakshatra and pada that fix the sequence, and the nine antardashas inside the mahadasha running on the "asof" date (the birth, when it is absent). The answer does not depend on the server clock, so it stays citable at a stable permalink.

The whole table hangs off one number, the Moon's sidereal longitude at the birth instant. The nakshatra it falls in names the first lord, and the share of that nakshatra still to be crossed, times the lord's years, is the balance at birth. A tenth of a degree moves the balance by weeks and every later boundary with it; a few degrees changes which planet the cycle opens with.

"time" is required here: the Moon covers about 13.2 degrees a day against a nakshatra 13 degrees 20 minutes wide, so an unknown birth time means an unknown first lord. Without it the call returns a "time_required" refusal. The cycle runs Ketu, Venus, Sun, Moon, Mars, Rahu, Jupiter, Saturn and Mercury, for 7, 20, 6, 10, 7, 18, 16, 19 and 17 years.

Three conventions come back in the result and are where two programs disagree about one chart: result.ayanamsa, result.yearLengthDays, result.origin.utcInstant. Against Drik Panchang every boundary here falls 1.70 days earlier; result.conventionNote explains the difference.

Results include an attribution line and a permalink.

asof.description: Date to mark the active mahadasha and antardasha for. Example: today's date for "which dasha am I in now".

date.description: Birth date, ISO YYYY-MM-DD, 1800-2200. Example: "1977-10-19". Other formats such as "19/10/1977" are refused.

lat.description: Birth latitude in decimal degrees as a string. Example: "39.76838". Paired with lon.

lon.description: Birth longitude in decimal degrees as a string. Example: "-86.15804". Paired with lat.

place.description: Town or city of birth with region or country. Example: "Chennai, India". An ambiguous name is refused with candidates.

time.description: Birth time HH:MM, 24-hour, local at the birthplace. Example: "23:58". Required; without it the call returns time_required.

tz.description: IANA zone or numeric UTC offset hours for the birth moment. Example: "-5". When absent, resolved historically.

name: compute_vimshottari_dasha
title: Compute a Vimshottari dasha timeline
